title: Tibial Footprint
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Use the posterior aspect of the footprint rather than the anterior when in doubt.
Expect the tibial end to be the weaker fixation early, because the bone is cancellous and the tunnel is in metaphysis rather than condyle.
Assess extension intraoperatively after graft passage and fixation.
In revision, grade the tibial bone and the tunnel position preoperatively.
